title: States & provinces
description: Explore states, provinces, and other regions within countries.
independentTracking: Regions and countries are tracked separately. Changing one does not change the other.
openCountry: Opens the region map and list
changeStatusHint: Choose whether this region is visited, lived, or on your wishlist
mapHint: Pinch to zoom. Tap a region to select it.
noResultsHint: Try another search or show all regions.
unavailableHint: This country has no separate regions in the bundled map data.
coverageNote: Coverage and region names follow Natural Earth. Administrative divisions vary by country, and some boundaries may be out of date or disputed.
attribution: Regional boundaries and names come from Natural Earth’s public-domain Admin 1 map. PastPins simplifies the boundaries for offline maps. Source coverage does not include every country or every recent boundary change.
